import re, sys
txt = open("pyproject.toml", encoding="utf-8").read()
vs = re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*version\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', txt)
sys.exit(0 if vs == ["1.2.0"] else 1)
files.hidden_reg_version.py:
import re, sys
txt = open("pyproject.toml", encoding="utf-8").read()
ok = bool(re.search(r'(?m)^\[project\]\s*$', txt)) and re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*name\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', txt) == ["tool"]
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
